mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in FEDFUNDS above 2.5% over three consecutive months signals a tightening cycle, raising discount rates and reducing present value of future corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20d forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered episodes, or the median return is not statistically different from zero at 5% significance.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly acceleration in GDPC1 above 3% annualized, combined with a concurrent rise in HOUST, indicates strengthening aggregate demand and consumer confidence, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 > 3% annualized AND HOUST > previous quarter for 2 consecutive quarters
failure_condition: S&P 500 60d forward returns are negative in more than 55% of triggered episodes, or the average return is not statistically above the median market return at 5% significance.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in UNRATE below 5% for three consecutive months signals weakening labor market conditions, reducing consumer purchasing power and corporate profit margins, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20d forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or the median return is not statistically different from zero at 5% significance.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent monthly decline in INDPRO below 90 for three consecutive months indicates contraction in industrial production, reflecting weakening business activity and reduced earnings potential, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20d forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or the average return is not statistically below zero at 5% significance.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp one-month drop in FEDFUNDS to below 0.25% during a recessionary environment signals an emergency easing, lowering risk-free rates and boosting equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < 0.25% AND UNRATE < 4% in the same month
failure_condition: S&P 500 60d forward returns are negative in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or the median return is not statistically above the median market return at 5% significance.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in RSAFS below its 12-month moving average by more than 5% signals a sharp drop in household savings, implying increased consumption spending and higher corporate revenues, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5d forward returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered episodes, or the average return is not statistically above zero at 5% significance.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in PAYEMS above 0.5% month-over-month and a fall in UNRATE below 4% signals labor market tightness with slack, boosting hiring but not wage inflation, which supports corporate margins and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20d forward returns are negative in more than 55% of triggered episodes, or the median return is not statistically above the median market return at 5% significance.

mechanism_narrative: A two-month consecutive increase in INDPRO above 102 signals a rebound in industrial activity after a contraction, improving earnings expectations and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO > 102 for 2 consecutive months after INDPRO < 90 in the prior month
failure_condition: S&P 500 20d forward returns are negative in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or the average return is not statistically above the median market return at 5% significance.
